6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

3094-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
3094-accept.text: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the $c trainer Gart. If this note is from Gart, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
3094-accept.title: Verdant Note

3094-complete.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-complete.text:
Though we share a common bond, do not expect much welcome from the night elves. Their pride still limits their sight, but that is none of our concern. The teachings of the Earthmother are all you must concern yourself with, and I will teach you what I know as you grow in wisdom.

Return to me often, $N. You will find that the Earthmother grants incredible abilities to those who are most dedicated.
3094-complete.title: Verdant Note

3094-progress.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-progress.text: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
3094-progress.title: Verdant Note

366-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-complete.text:
My book?!?  So you were the thief who stole it!

But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor?  He is in  Lordaeron?

If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
366-complete.title: Return the Book

409-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-accept.text:
You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.

There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.

Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
409-accept.title: Proving Allegiance

409-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-complete.text:
You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge.  Incredible.

I had believed I was the only $R with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.
409-complete.title: Proving Allegiance

409-progress.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-progress.text: I await proof of your allegiance, $C.
409-progress.title: Proving Allegiance

410-complete.name: Unknown
410-complete.text: You place the Candle of Beckoning upon the table and light it...
410-complete.title: The Dormant Shade

410-progress.name: Unknown
410-progress.text: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
410-progress.title: The Dormant Shade

411-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
411-accept.text: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor.  It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
411-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

431-complete.name: Unknown
431-complete.text: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
431-complete.title: Candles of Beckoning

747-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-accept.text:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. $R hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
747-accept.title: The Hunt Begins

747-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you, $N. You show much promise.
747-complete.title: The Hunt Begins

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

750-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-accept.text:
A $r skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
750-accept.title: The Hunt Continues

750-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you for these provisions, $N. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
750-complete.title: The Hunt Continues

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

752-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
752-accept.text:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
752-accept.title: A Humble Task

752-complete.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
752-complete.text: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper? Here, take one of these training manuals with you, so you may learn how to contribute to the community.
752-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-accept.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
753-accept.text:
I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.

But you look like an eager $c. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.

Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
753-accept.title: A Humble Task

753-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-complete.text:
You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

Your willingness to help others and provide for the $r of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
753-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

755-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
755-accept.text:
Your willingness to perform a humble task for the $r of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, $N. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a $c of greatness.

Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
755-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

755-complete.name: Seer Graytongue
755-complete.text: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
755-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

95805-progress.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
